mapper.select: SELECT transaction_row.account_transaction_id AS transactionId, account_row.user_id AS userId, transaction_row.transaction_category AS transactionCategory, CAST(transaction_row.out_amount AS SIGNED) AS outAmount, CAST(transaction_row.in_amount AS SIGNED) AS inAmount, account_row.organization_code AS organizationCode, transaction_row.loan_transaction_type_name AS loanTransactionTypeName, transaction_row.desc1, transaction_row.desc2, transaction_row.desc3, transaction_row.desc4 FROM ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION transaction_row INNER JOIN ACCOUNT account_row ON account_row.account_id = transaction_row.account_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TXN_ANALYSIS analysis_row WHERE analysis_row.account_transaction_id = transaction_row.account_transaction_id ) AND ( ( transaction_row.transaction_category = 'ORDINARY' AND transaction_row.out_amount > 0 ) OR ( transaction_row.transaction_category = 'INSTALLMENT' AND transaction_row.in_amount > 0 ) OR ( transaction_row.transaction_category = 'LOAN' AND transaction_row.out_amount > 0 ) ) ORDER BY transaction_row.account_transaction_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT transaction_row.account_transaction_id AS transactionId, account_row.user_id AS userId, transaction_row.transaction_category AS transactionCategory, CAST(transaction_row.out_amount AS SIGNED) AS outAmount, CAST(transaction_row.in_amount AS SIGNED) AS inAmount, account_row.organization_code AS organizationCode, transaction_row.loan_transaction_type_name AS loanTransactionTypeName, transaction_row.desc1, transaction_row.desc2, transaction_row.desc3, transaction_row.desc4 FROM ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION transaction_row INNER JOIN ACCOUNT account_row ON account_row.account_id = transaction_row.account_id WHERE account_row.user_id = #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TXN_ANALYSIS analysis_row WHERE analysis_row.account_transaction_id = transaction_row.account_transaction_id ) AND ( ( transaction_row.transaction_category = 'ORDINARY' AND transaction_row.out_amount > 0 ) OR ( transaction_row.transaction_category = 'INSTALLMENT' AND transaction_row.in_amount > 0 ) OR ( transaction_row.transaction_category = 'LOAN' AND transaction_row.out_amount > 0 ) ) ORDER BY transaction_row.account_transaction_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: account_row.account_id AS id, account_row.codef_connection_id AS codefConnectionId, account_row.user_id AS userId, connection_row.provider AS connectionProvider, account_row.organization_code AS organizationCode, account_row.account_group AS accountGroup, account_row.deposit_type_code AS depositTypeCode, account_row.account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, account_row.account_no_hash AS accountNoHash, account_row.account_name AS accountName, account_row.balance, account_row.loan_contract_principal AS loanContractPrincipal, account_row.interest_rate AS interestRate, account_row.currency_code AS currencyCode, account_row.account_start_date AS accountStartDate, account_row.maturity_date AS maturityDate, account_row.last_tran_date AS lastTranDate, account_row.overdraft_yn AS overdraftYn, account_row.next_payment_date AS nextPaymentDate, account_row.status, account_row.deactivated_at AS deactivatedAt, account_row.created_at AS createdAt, account_row.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ACCOUNT account_row INNER JOIN CODEF_CONNECTION connection_row ON connection_row.codef_connection_id = account_row.codef_connection_id WHERE account_row.user_id = #{userId} AND account_row.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY account_row.account_id

SELECT FROM ACCOUNT account_row INNER JOIN CODEF_CONNECTION connection_row ON connection_row.codef_connection_id = account_row.codef_connection_id WHERE account_row.account_id = #{accountId} AND account_row.user_id = #{userId} AND account_row.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT transaction_row.account_transaction_id AS transactionId, NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_row.desc3), '') AS merchantName, CONCAT_WS( ' | ', NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_row.desc2), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_row.desc3), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_row.desc4), '') ) AS description, CAST(transaction_row.out_amount AS SIGNED) AS amount, TIMESTAMP( transaction_row.tran_date, transaction_row.tran_time ) AS transactionDate FROM ACCOUNT account_row INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION transaction_row ON transaction_row.account_id = account_row.account_id WHERE ORDER BY transaction_row.tran_date, transaction_row.tran_time, transaction_row.account_transaction_id
